paper.title_en: Dark Matter Signatures in Black Hole Thermodynamics and Information Recovery
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the thermodynamic properties and information recovery of Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr"om black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter. We show that, while the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy remains unchanged, dark matter significantly modifies the Hawking temperature by introducing a positive contribution that enhances thermal effects, particularly for small black holes. We find that the phase structure is preserved: Schwarzschild black holes remain unstable, whereas Reissner--Nordstr"om black holes exhibit the standard small/large black hole transition, in which small black holes are stable and large black holes are unstable. Furthermore, we demonstrate that dark matter accelerates Hawking evaporation, thereby reducing black hole lifetimes. We further investigate the black hole information loss paradox using the island formula. In the absence of islands, the entanglement entropy of Hawking radiation grows linearly with time and diverges at late times, thereby violating unitarity. By including island contributions, the entanglement entropy of Hawking radiation saturates at twice the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy, reproducing the Page curve and restoring information recovery for both Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr"om black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter. We derive analytical expressions for the Page time and demonstrate that it is directly determined by the thermodynamic parameters of the black hole. Furthermore, we establish a correspondence between thermodynamics and information recovery by showing that the Page time is governed by the Hawking temperature and the event horizon. Finally, we find that the presence of dark matter reduces the Page time, thereby accelerating information recovery.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文深入研究了黑洞热力学性质与信息恢复，探讨了暗物质的影响，并利用岛公式再现了Page曲线，具有较高的理论深度和创新性，适合推荐阅读。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞热力学与信息恢复中的暗物质信号
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了被完美流体暗物质包围的Schwarzschild和Reissner--Nordström黑洞的热力学性质和信息恢复。我们证明，虽然Bekenstein--Hawking熵保持不变，但暗物质显著修改了Hawking温度，引入了一个增强热效应的正贡献，特别是对小黑洞。我们发现相结构得以保留：Schwarzschild黑洞仍然不稳定，而Reissner--Nordström黑洞表现出标准的小/大黑洞转变，其中小黑洞稳定而大黑洞不稳定。此外，我们证明暗物质加速了Hawking蒸发，从而缩短了黑洞的寿命。我们进一步使用岛公式研究黑洞信息丢失悖论。在没有岛的情况下，Hawking辐射的纠缠熵随时间线性增长，并在晚期发散，从而违反了幺正性。通过包括岛的贡献，Hawking辐射的纠缠熵饱和为Bekenstein--Hawking熵的两倍，重现了Page曲线，并恢复了被完美流体暗物质包围的Schwarzschild和Reissner--Nordström黑洞的信息恢复能力。我们推导了Page时间的解析表达式，并证明它直接由黑洞的热力学参数决定。此外，我们通过表明Page时间由Hawking温度和事件视界控制，建立了热力学与信息恢复之间的对应关系。最后，我们发现暗物质的存在缩短了Page时间，从而加速了信息恢复。
